Project Title:
Real-Time Stock Sentiment Quantification using Pandas, Tweepy, FinBERT, and Moving Average Crossovers
Reference ID: ai-ml-ds-SrmZNuoOhMk
Filename: real_time_stock_sentiment_quantification.py

Short Description:
This project integrates real-time Twitter data streaming with financial sentiment analysis using FinBERT, and applies moving average crossover strategies to generate trading signals. It leverages Pandas for data manipulation, Tweepy for Twitter API interaction, and FinBERT for sentiment analysis.

Problem Domain:
Financial Market Analysis, Real-Time Data Processing, Sentiment Analysis, Algorithmic Trading.

Use Cases:

  • Real-time monitoring of stock-related sentiments on Twitter.
  • Generating trading signals based on sentiment trends and moving average crossovers.
  • Backtesting trading strategies based on historical sentiment data.

Trading Signal: Buy (if short-term MA crosses above long-term MA)

Python Code:

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import tweepy
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
import torch
from torch.nn.functional import softmax
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Constants
BEARER_TOKEN: str = 'YOUR_TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN'
STOCK_SYMBOL: str = 'AAPL'
SHORT_WINDOW: int = 5
LONG_WINDOW: int = 20

# Initialize FinBERT
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('ProsusAI/finbert')
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('ProsusAI/finbert')

# Initialize DataFrame
columns = ['timestamp', 'tweet', 'sentiment_score']
data: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame(columns=columns)

# Tweepy Stream Listener
class StockTweetListener(tweepy.StreamingClient):
    def on_tweet(self, tweet):
        text: str = tweet.text
        timestamp: datetime = datetime.utcnow()
        inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True)
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
        sentiment_score: float = probs[0][2].item() - probs[0][0].item()
        global data
        data = data.append({'timestamp': timestamp, 'tweet': text, 'sentiment_score': sentiment_score}, ignore_index=True)
        print(f"{timestamp} | Sentiment Score: {sentiment_score:.4f} | Tweet: {text}")

# Start Streaming
def start_stream():
    stream = StockTweetListener(bearer_token=BEARER_TOKEN)
    stream.add_rules(tweepy.StreamRule(value=STOCK_SYMBOL))
    stream.filter(tweet_fields=["created_at"])

# Compute Moving Averages and Generate Signals
def analyze_sentiment():
    df: pd.DataFrame = data.copy()
    df['timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'])
    df.set_index('timestamp', inplace=True)
    df = df.resample('1T').mean().fillna(method='ffill')
    df['short_ma'] = df['sentiment_score'].rolling(window=SHORT_WINDOW).mean()
    df['long_ma'] = df['sentiment_score'].rolling(window=LONG_WINDOW).mean()
    df['signal'] = 0
    df['signal'][SHORT_WINDOW:] = np.where(df['short_ma'][SHORT_WINDOW:] > df['long_ma'][SHORT_WINDOW:], 1, 0)
    df['position'] = df['signal'].diff()
    plt.figure(figsize=(14,7))
    plt.plot(df.index, df['sentiment_score'], label='Sentiment Score', alpha=0.5)
    plt.plot(df.index, df['short_ma'], label=f'Short MA ({SHORT_WINDOW})', alpha=0.9)
    plt.plot(df.index, df['long_ma'], label=f'Long MA ({LONG_WINDOW})', alpha=0.9)
    plt.plot(df[df['position'] == 1].index, df['short_ma'][df['position'] == 1], '^', markersize=10, color='g', label='Buy Signal')
    plt.plot(df[df['position'] == -1].index, df['short_ma'][df['position'] == -1], 'v', markersize=10, color='r', label='Sell Signal')
    plt.title(f'{STOCK_SYMBOL} Sentiment Analysis with Moving Average Crossover')
    plt.xlabel('Time')
    plt.ylabel('Sentiment Score')
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid()
    plt.show()

# Main Execution
if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        start_stream()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        analyze_sentiment()

Advanced Functionalities Implemented:

  • Real-Time Data Streaming: Utilizes Tweepy's StreamingClient to capture live tweets related to the specified stock symbol.
  • Financial Sentiment Analysis: Applies FinBERT, a BERT-based model fine-tuned for financial texts, to assess the sentiment of each tweet.
  • Moving Average Crossover Strategy: Computes short-term and long-term moving averages of sentiment scores to generate buy/sell signals.
  • Data Resampling and Forward Filling: Resamples sentiment scores into 1-minute intervals and applies forward filling to handle missing data.
  • Visualization: Plots sentiment scores, moving averages, and trading signals for intuitive analysis.

Next Steps for Enhancement:

  • Integration with Trading Platforms: Connect the system to trading APIs to execute trades automatically based on generated signals.
  • Sentiment Aggregation from Multiple Sources: Incorporate news articles, financial reports, and other social media platforms for a more comprehensive sentiment analysis.
  • Machine Learning Models for Signal Prediction: Train models to predict stock price movements based on sentiment trends and other financial indicators.
  • Dashboard Development: Create an interactive dashboard to monitor real-time sentiment scores and trading signals.
